name: Anduril
summary: Defense hardware and software growing quickly—with manufacturing costs and execution risks to match.
overview: Anduril combines autonomous defense hardware with its Lattice software platform. The report argues that building products before contracts are guaranteed can speed innovation, but also puts development risk on the company. Its growth is compelling; whether its valuation reflects achievable economics is the harder question.
